tagline: Mid-engined supercars and hypercars as hover jets: cab forward, turbine behind the cabin, jets at every corner.

wedge.name: Wedge
wedge.note: 70s-80s poster wedge: one flat line from nose to roof, low flat roof, upright tail glass and a hard notch down to low shoulder air boxes.

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap to the nose
rear seam plate: dark linkage to the engine deck
tub side: the flat pad every side pod lands on
belt stripe: accent runs through every kit
low shoulder air box: the roof drops to it in a hard notch

curve.name: Curve
curve.note: 90s teardrop: long raked screen from far forward, a short thin roof at the peak, glass fastback that tapers in plan, flying buttresses that carry the roofline down the deck.

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap to the nose
rear seam plate: dark linkage to the engine deck
tub side: the flat pad every side pod lands on
belt stripe: accent runs through every kit
thin roof: the peak of the teardrop
flying buttress: the roofline runs down the deck

hyper.name: Hyper
hyper.note: Modern hypercar: very narrow fighter canopy on wide flat shoulder wings, roof snorkel, dorsal fin over the turbine.

rear seam plate: dark linkage to the engine deck
tub side: the flat pad every side pod lands on

shoulder wing: overhangs the side pod

spider.name: Spider
spider.note: Open spider: low wrap screen, no roof, driver in the open, two slim roll humps with short tails behind the seats.

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap to the nose
rear seam plate: dark linkage to the engine deck
tub side: the flat pad every side pod lands on
belt stripe: accent runs through every kit

longtail.name: Longtail
longtail.note: Endurance longtail: low bubble, small side glass, long roof scoop, thick twin tail fins that rise from the deck to the rear.

gull.name: Gull
gull.note: Gullwing: short steep screen, a double-bubble glass roof either side of a raised hinge spine, bulged doors that overhang the side pods, a falling glass cover over the turbine.

parts.note: front seam plate: dark linkage in the shadow gap to the nose
rear seam plate: dark linkage to the engine deck
tub side: the flat pad every side pod lands on
belt stripe: accent runs through every kit
roof bubble over each seat: top at Y 4.85
bubble nose: stands proud of the screen
bubble tail: a round end to the cabin
raised roof spine: the door hinge line
door cant rail: the door cut runs up to it
door cut, front: rises into the roof
gullwing door glass: overhangs the side pod
glass engine cover: falls to the rear

mono.name: Mono Turbine
mono.note: Wedge: one fat round turbine the full length of the bay, bellmouth forward, bleed ducts down both flanks, one big nozzle straight out the back.

twin.name: Twin Spool
twin.note: Analogue: two turbines side by side the full length of the bay, a shared plenum, dark heat-shield rails, twin nozzles. No glass: the cockpit owns all glass.

top.name: Top-Exit Core
top.note: Hypercar: a round core set back in the bay behind a flat ram scoop, two fat stacks beside it that fire straight up.

stacks.name: Eight Stack
stacks.note: Track special: low block under eight open intake trumpets, twin fat megaphone nozzles.

long.name: Lance Turbine
long.note: Longtail: one slim tube down the bay under a snorkel scoop with an open mouth, flaring in plan to a tall wide fishtail nozzle with three glowing cells.

cross.name: Cross Plenum
cross.note: Concept: a chamfered box plenum set across the bay with a periscope intake and square side intakes, two slim pipes down the bay edges to twin nozzles.

box.name: Ram Boxes
box.note: Wedge: one tall square ram box per side, hard against the cabin, big square nozzle over the arch.

round.name: Round Pods
round.note: Analogue: one short round pod per side, set back over the arch on a pylon.

twin.name: Stacked Pairs
twin.note: Hypercar: two tubes per side stacked one above the other, held outboard on a thin pylon. Four nozzles.

stub.name: Stub Burners
stub.note: Track special: fat short burner at the very tail, fed by a painted box duct from a big trumpet behind the cabin.

parts.note: feed duct: low, flat and painted

lance.name: Long Lances
lance.note: Longtail: one long exposed tube per side on a low narrow fairing, bellmouth behind the cabin, nozzle past the tail.

ear.name: Ear Scoops
ear.note: Concept: tall narrow ear scoop tight against the cabin, a duct that falls into a long pipe to the tail.

vector.name: Vector Pods
vector.note: Wedge: one long slim pod per corner with a nozzle vectored down and back, small fin on top.

lift.name: Twin Lift Cans
lift.note: Analogue: two short upright lift cans per corner, tucked up into the arch. The only upright-can option.

parts.note: lift can shroud, up in the arch
thrust: ends level with the splitters

blade.name: Aero Blades
blade.note: Hypercar: an exposed nacelle in the arch with its nozzle angled down and back, a swept active blade standing on its outer edge.

parts.note: blade root: starts above the nacelle
swept active blade, outboard of the body
blade root: starts above the nacelle
swept active blade, outboard of the body

out.name: Outriggers
out.note: Track special: slender nacelle held out on two wishbone arms, pitched nose-up, tail fin.

trio.name: Skirt Trios
trio.note: Longtail: a louvred skirt along the arch over a cascade of three flat slot nozzles raked down and back. No cans.

tip.name: Canard Tip Jets
tip.note: Concept: a flat canard plane out of each arch, a long slim jet on its tip, one lift jet under it.

quad.name: Quad Cans
quad.note: Wedge: four long slim cans spread in a row.

parts.note: back plate on the tail wall

tri.name: Tri Cluster
tri.note: Hypercar: three cans in a wide triangle, one fat short can high over two slim long ones set wide apart. All three glows show from behind.

parts.note: lower can: slim, and runs past the tail

slot.name: Slot Burner
slot.note: Track special: one wide flat slot burner with vanes, very short.

split.name: Split Slots
split.note: Concept: two tall narrow slot burners set wide apart, nothing in the middle.

parts.note: cross manifold on the tail wall

shovel.name: Shovel Nose
shovel.note: Wedge: one flat plane from a long chisel lip to the scuttle. Nothing ahead of the arches, box flares that hang over them.

droplet.name: Droplet Nose
droplet.note: Analogue: short rounded bonnet, tall peaked fenders over the arches with round lamps in their fronts. Nothing ahead of the arches.

parts.note: fender vent: finished face at the cabin seam

keel.name: Keel Nose
keel.note: Hypercar: raised needle keel that widens to the scuttle through faceted shoulders, open air channels under them, fender blades with prows and light bars.

parts.note: inner shoulder: the keel widens toward the scuttle
outer shoulder: joins the fender blade

blunt.name: Blunt Nose
blunt.note: Track special: short blunt face with a big intake and lamps in it, bonnet extractor, half fenders over the arches, twin dive planes.

parts.note: half fender: the outer half of the arch stays open so the jet shows
low fender wall behind the arch

lowline.name: Lowline Nose
lowline.note: Longtail: two long tall lamp towers ahead of the arches, a recessed valley between them, fenders that fall to the belt.

visor.name: Visor Nose
visor.note: Concept: flat low platform the full width ahead of bare arches, full-width light visor, steep ramp to the scuttle.

parts.note: centre deck: stabiliser hardpoint on its side

slab.name: Slab Deck
slab.note: Wedge: boxy full-width deck, square haunches, tall square corners, tail chopped square just behind the wing pads.

parts.note: rail: side engine and stabiliser hardpoint
engine bay pad: every main turbine lands here
tail post: wing pad on top

boat.name: Boat Tail
boat.note: Analogue: smooth belly with no undertray step, round haunches, no tail corners, a boat tail that narrows in plan and droops, four round lamps.

parts.note: rail: side engine and stabiliser hardpoint
engine bay pad: every main turbine lands here
afterburner shelf: its flat belly is the diffuser hardpoint
tail post: wing pad on top

tunnel.name: Tunnel Tail
tunnel.note: Hypercar: a centre spine, open channels either side, slim longerons on arms, swept intake fins and wake fins.

parts.note: engine bay pad: every main turbine lands here
intake fin, swept up to the arch
wake fin, swept down to the tail
tail post: wing pad on top

frame.name: Frame Tail
frame.note: Track special: a painted engine cradle inside a bare tube frame, vented haunches that fall to the arch, short low corners, crash structure and rain light.

parts.note: arch hardpoint for the stabiliser arm
painted engine cradle: nothing is see-through
engine bay pad: every main turbine lands here
tail post: wing pad on top

streamer.name: Streamer Tail
streamer.note: Longtail: smooth belly with a tray under the tail only, haunches that swell in plan, drooping tail corners, twin tail booms that run far past the afterburner.

parts.note: rail: side engine and stabiliser hardpoint
engine bay pad: every main turbine lands here
tail corner, raised over the diffuser
tail post: wing pad on top

kamm.name: Kamm Tail
kamm.note: Concept: twin hulls with an open venturi tunnel under the turbine, no haunch and no corners, sheer cut-off tail with a light band.

parts.note: hull side: side engine and stabiliser hardpoint
engine bay pad: every main turbine lands here
afterburner shelf over the tunnel exit
tail post: wing pad on top

strake.name: Strake Intakes
strake.note: Wedge: nothing at the front. A straked intake wedge rises from the door to the side engine.

parts.note: intake wedge rises to the side engine
outlet face toward the side engine

round.name: Torpedo Pods
round.note: Analogue: a round torpedo pod hung off the tub on two pylons, bullet nose, open outlet.

blade.name: Floating Blades
blade.note: Hypercar: no pod at all. A low thin blade stands off the tub on two struts and air runs behind it.

parts.note: floating blade: low, so the tub side shows
blade tip rises to the side engine

tray.name: Barge Trays
tray.note: Track special: wide floor tray under the door, upright barge board behind the front arch, small low radiator pod.

slab.name: Full Fairings
slab.note: Longtail: smooth full-height fairing flush with the fenders, flush duct, long stripe.

waist.name: Waisted Cheeks
waist.note: Concept: a low cheek intake behind the front arch that tapers in plan to nothing at the rear: a pinched waist.

rain light on the fin end

fins.name: Tail Fins
fins.note: Two outboard tail planes with a rising fin on each. The centre is open so the main turbine exhaust shows.
